title: Create a reading topic that remembers your choices
goal: synchronizes CSS themes, button accessibility states, and local preferences.
summary: adds dark mode to the reading panel. Restores the last selection when the page is reopened and expresses the current mode accessible with a pressed state.
tasks: in style.css is #reader[data-theme="dark"], covering --surface as #15243a and --ink as #f0f4f8.
Initialize and switch the data-theme of #reader in script.js. Use light for light colors and dark for dark colors. aria-pressed to sync #theme-toggle.
Write selection to reader-theme. Use a light color when there is no recording for the first time, and restore the saved theme on startup.

example.note: Custom properties are responsible for theme visuals. The data attribute gives the current interface state to CSS, and the storage key is responsible for restoring the page after it is closed.

hint: uses a function to update data-theme and aria-pressed at the same time. It is called when the page is initialized and when the button is clicked.
